summary.intent: Execute Phase 22 (performance baselines completion) on the cipher-box project, clean up the resulting code, populate journey timing baselines against staging, and get PR #355 reviewed and ready to merge.
summary.outcome: Phase 22 executed successfully (3/3 plans, 9/9 verification must-haves), code cleaned up via simplify review, staging DB reset to fix a vault init bug, journey timing baselines populated from live staging runs, and all PR review threads (15 total across 4 rounds) resolved with fixes committed.

repo: Phase 22 commits were accidentally made directly to main before being moved to feat/phase-22-performance-baselines-completion via branch reset
Staging DB had not been reset after Phase 20 vault migration removed encrypted_root_folder_key and encrypted_root_ipns_private_key columns — schema mismatch caused 500 errors on new wallet logins
Playwright wallet injection via installMockWallet + page.addInitScript works with EIP-6963 auto-announcement; multi-account tests use separate browser contexts with independent wallets
Web3Auth Core Kit MPC init dominates login-to-vault journey at ~23.5s; vault load after auth is only ~86ms
Journey timing baselines: login-to-vault 23,569ms, upload-to-visible 1,355ms (100KB), share-to-accessible 3,039ms
The __CIPHERBOX_PERF__ opt-in flag is used to enable perf instrumentation in browser dev environments rather than relying on NODE_ENV
Load test scenarios use a Vitest-based harness, not k6 — REQUIREMENTS.md and ROADMAP.md had outdated k6 references
unpinFromIpfs was not instrumented with withPerf unlike addToIpfs and fetchFromIpfs

code.finding: PERF_ENABLED check needed typeof process.env?.NODE_ENV guard to avoid being true in browser production via process polyfill
PerformanceMeasure entries were not cleared after creation, causing unbounded accumulation; clearMeasures() added after measure creation
Parallel withPerf calls with the same operation name caused mark name collisions; fixed by adding per-invocation counter to mark names
404 check was missing error.response.status — Axios puts HTTP status on error.response.status not error.status
Silent skip on missing metric in checkThresholds is intentional design — returns false rather than throwing
JSDoc said 'Combines checkThresholds + console.warn + expect' but implementation uses throw, not expect
globalThis mock used 'as any' cast; replaced with declare global block for proper typing
Login flow duplication across journeys is intentional for sub-phase timing capture, not a code smell

workflow: GSD phase execute workflow correctly skips plans with existing SUMMARY.md on re-run, enabling safe resumption
Playwright tests can target staging by overriding baseURL via env var (BASE_URL=https://...) with a temp config that skips webServer entries
The classifyHandoffIfNeeded error is a known Claude Code runtime bug that fires after tool calls complete — spot-check SUMMARY.md + git commits to determine actual success
GitHub Actions lint-pr-title workflow suddenly required manual approval despite no workflow file changes — likely a GitHub platform settings change
Stale background task notifications from executor subagents can arrive after phase completion and can be safely ignored
PR review cycles with CodeRabbit + Copilot generated 15 threads across 4 rounds; resolving via GraphQL mutation after REST reply is the correct flow

friction: Phase 22 planning commits were accidentally made directly to main and had to be moved to a feature branch via reset
Staging DB schema mismatch (Phase 20 migration not applied) caused vault init 500 errors that blocked journey timing test runs
Playwright staging run required a temp config file workaround because webServer entries in the main config attempt to start local services
GitHub Actions workflow started requiring manual approval for lint-pr-title despite no workflow changes — root cause unknown, required manual intervention
Extra usage limit hit mid-session causing a pause in execution
OAuth token expired mid-session requiring re-authentication
Background task notifications from subagents arrived out of order and caused confusion about phase completion state
GSD phase complete tool returned next_phase: 23 even though phase 23 was already marked complete in ROADMAP.md
open_items: Journey timing baselines populated from staging but marked PENDING for browser DevTools Performance API mark verification (human verification item from phase 22)
Phases 21, 22, and 23 were executed out of order — phase 21 is still actively being worked on
PERF_ENABLED in browser dev environments requires explicitly setting __CIPHERBOX_PERF__ in the web app entrypoint — not done in this PR, deferred as out of scope
GitHub Actions approval requirement for lint-pr-title needs investigation in repo Settings > Actions > General
